title: [29.x][All-e]"Specify the VAT registration number that you want to verify" error when entering a VAT Registration No. in the Sales Order if the Customer Card has no VAT Registration No.
summary: Sales Header VAT Registration No. validation now checks the number entered on the document instead of the customer card number, allowing verification of different numbers.
key_points: Passes a copy of the customer record with the entered VAT number to validation instead of the original customer card
Preserves the existing rule that only fills a blank customer VAT number automatically
Allows verification of VAT numbers different from those on the customer card
Fixes error when customer card has no VAT number but document entry requires validation
quote: The field now passes a copy of the customer (CustomerToValidate) with the number entered on the document set.
